rules.rationale: Workload Profile is set to Efficiency_FavorPerformance. Balanced mode; for lowest latency, configure Virtualization_MaxPerformance.

rules.rationale: CPU C-States is set to Autonomous, allowing ESXi power governance and preventing deep C-state sleep jitter.

rules.rationale: CPU Turbo Mode is Enabled. Allows processors to opportunistically boost clock rates above nominal TDP baseline.
rules.citation: VMware vSphere 9.0 Performance Best Practices, General BIOS Settings (p. 21)

rules.rationale: Hyper-Threading is Enabled. Maximizes vCPU scheduling capacity and throughput for ESXi NUMA scheduler.
rules.citation: VMware vSphere 9.0 Performance Best Practices, Hyper-Threading (p. 26) & General BIOS Settings (p. 21)

rules.rationale: Sub-NUMA Clustering is set to Disable, exposing 1 NUMA node per physical socket for predictable VM memory placement.
rules.citation: vSphere 9.0 Performance Best Practices, Memory Virtualization Considerations (p. 22)

rules.rationale: Hardware Prefetcher is Enabled. Streams contiguous cache lines into L2/L3 caches in advance of instructions.
rules.citation: vSphere 9.0 Performance Best Practices, Memory Performance (p. 22)

rules.rationale: System Boot Mode is configured for UEFI. Required for modern ESXi, Secure Boot, and VCF 9.1.
rules.citation: vSphere 9.0 Performance Best Practices, Boot Options (p. 16)

rules.rationale: MONITOR/MWAIT is Enabled. (Note: Generic LP1836 Maximum Performance preset disables MONITOR/MWAIT, but VMware-specific advisory HT115952 takes precedence).
